# cubrid-client

> Modern TypeScript-first client for the CUBRID database. Promise-based, fully typed API for Node.js 18+ applications.

cubrid-client provides a clean, typed wrapper around the CUBRID database for Node.js and TypeScript projects. It features generic query result typing, structured error classes, and transaction support.

Key facts:
- Large results: `for await (const row of db.stream<User>("SELECT * FROM users")) { ... }` holds one server reply at a time; a statement awaited on the same client inside the loop rejects with `kind: "stream-busy"`, so use `db.transaction()` or another client there
- Install: `npm install cubrid-client`
- Connect: `createClient({ host: "localhost", port: 33000, database: "demodb", user: "dba" })`
- Query: `await db.query<User>("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", [1])`
- Transactions: `await db.transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.query(...) })`
- Isolation and locks: `isolationLevel` (`"read committed"`, `"repeatable read"`, `"serializable"`) and `lockTimeout` (ms, `0` no wait, `-1` no limit) on `createClient()` or as `transaction(callback, options)`; restored on every new session, and a connection that cannot apply them fails. `serializable` still allows write skew
- Collections: SET, MULTISET and SEQUENCE columns return JavaScript arrays (`CollectionValue`); `{1,'a'}`-style mixed-type collections arrive from the server as SQL NULL
- A callback transaction has one outcome: `tx` rejects with `TransactionError` once it is committed or rolled back; `error.cause` keeps the original failure, with cleanup failures on `error.rollbackError` and `error.closeError`
- Error classes: `ConnectionError`, `QueryError`, `TransactionError`, `ReadTimeoutError`; `ConstraintError`, `SqlSyntaxError`, `DeadlockError` and `LockTimeoutError` extend `QueryError`
- Error details: `code` (numeric server code), `origin`, `kind` and optional `sqlState`
- ESM and CommonJS output
- Node.js 18+ support
- TypeScript-first with full generic type support

## Examples

- [Quick Start](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): Basic connection and query
- [Typed Queries](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/README.md#typed-queries): Generic type parameter for query results
- [Transactions](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/README.md#transactions): Isolated transactional connections with auto-rollback
- [CUBRID Cookbook — cubrid-client](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-cookbook/tree/main/node/cubrid): Production-ready examples — connect, CRUD, transactions

## API Reference

- [Source — create-client.ts](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/src/client/create-client.ts): Client factory function
- [Source — client.ts](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/src/client/client.ts): Client class with query and close methods
- [Source — transaction.ts](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-client/blob/main/src/client/transaction.ts): Transaction implementation

## Ecosystem

- [drizzle-cubrid](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/drizzle-cubrid): Drizzle ORM dialect for CUBRID (uses cubrid-client as driver)
- [cubrid-cookbook](https://github.com/cubrid-lab/cubrid-cookbook): Production-ready examples across Python, Node.js, and Go
- [CUBRID](https://www.cubrid.org/): The CUBRID database
